Tenable

TEN-uh-bul · adjective

Hear It

What It Means

Tenable is able to be defended or maintained against attack, objection, or criticism.

The city council's original budget plan was no longer tenable once auditors revealed it relied on numbers that had been miscalculated for three years running.

Worked Example

The general refused to admit that the isolated outpost, surrounded on three sides and low on supplies, was no longer a tenable position to hold.

Tenable describes something -- a position, an argument, a plan -- that can still be successfully defended against challenge or attack.

Compare the words

Synonyms · words with a similar meaning

defensible: able to be justified or protected against attack

sound: well-founded and free of error

What it isn’t · antonyms and near-opposites

untenable: impossible to defend or maintain

flimsy: so weak it falls apart when tested or challenged

Where it sits · how well it stands up to challenge — reasonable → tenable → airtight

reasonable vs. tenable: Reasonable just means an idea makes sense on its face -- it says nothing about whether it could survive serious challenge.

airtight vs. tenable: An airtight argument goes even further than tenable -- it has no weaknesses left for an opponent to attack at all.

Build the Word

The pieces

root — ten-

root — ten-: to hold (Latin tenere)

suffix — -able

suffix — -able: able to be (Latin -abilis)

Put it together

Put it together: Tenable comes from Latin tenere ('to hold') -- the same root behind tenacious, which you already met earlier in this course. A tenable position is, at root, one that can still be 'held' against attack.

Use the root in a new word: tenacious

Use the root in a new word: tenacious: The tenacious reporter refused to give up the story, even after three sources turned her down.

Root Check

Word Choice

Tenable most often describes an argument, position, theory, or plan -- something that can still be logically defended. It rarely describes people directly; you'd call an argument tenable, not a person.
